title.narrative: Promoting energy efficiency of cool rooms - cold chambers and refrigerated display counters in Chile

description.narrative: The Chilean Ministry of Environment, through the National Ozone unit (NOU) has invited UNIDO to participate in a consortium of relevant organizations, which will apply to the open call for proposals under the new financial windows of the Kigali Cooling Efficiency Program (K-CEP), launched in January 2020 and called the NDC Support Facility for Efficient, Climate-Friendly Cooling (NDC Support Facility). It provides funding and guidance to organizations to support governments that want to integrate cooling solutions into the next round of their country#s Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), which are expected to be submitted during 2020.The counterparts include the Ministry of Energy of Chile who has been leading the efforts in energy efficiency The goal of the NDC Support Facility aim to unlock the potential of emissions reductions in the cooling sector by supporting Chile to optimize the contribution that efficient, climate-friendly cooling can make to their updated NDCs program. The scope proposed by the NOU and partners is to promote energy efficiency of cold chambers and display cases by elaborating guidelines of low carbon design, installation and operation.
